text: {"components": [{"type": "condition", "quote": "the scope for more than one planning zone is deemed insufficient", "gist": "when multiple planning zones are not feasible"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "submit a proposal to the SFOE for a single planning zone", "gist": "applicant must propose a single planning zone to SFOE"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "with the consent of the involved cantons", "gist": "applicant requires canton approval"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "prepare at least two corridors in the planning zone and submits the necessary documentation to the SFOE", "gist": "applicant must prepare corridors and submit documentation to SFOE"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SFOE", "gist": "Swiss Federal Office of Energy (or similar authority)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "support group", "gist": "a designated advisory or review group"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "submit the documentation to the support group", "gist": "SFOE must send documentation to the support group"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "arrange for an on-site visit by the support group", "gist": "SFOE may organize a site inspection by the support group"}]}
